recommendation_1: Reduce mid_dim from 256 to 64 to significantly decrease the number of trainable parameters and memory footprint.
rationale_1: Lowering mid_dim reduces the hidden layer size, directly decreasing both RAM usage and computational requirements, which aligns with energy efficiency goals.
recommendation_3: Switch activation function from Swish back to ReLU to reduce computational complexity and improve energy efficiency.
rationale_3: Swish introduces additional computation per layer; reverting to ReLU maintains performance while minimizing resource consumption, especially beneficial in low-power settings.
recommendation_4: Replace AdamW optimizer with SGD optimizer using momentum to reduce memory overhead and computational cost during training.
rationale_4: SGD requires less memory than AdamW due to its simpler state tracking mechanism, reducing peak RAM usage and improving training efficiency in resource-constrained devices.
